messages:
rachel: Quick heads-upnoticed a cluster of SAST alerts after yesterday's RBAC tidy-up. Most hits are exec()/tmp file patterns under tools/ and infra/ :thinking_face:
ton y: Which SA was changed? We had a pruning of the old deploy SAs last night.
build-bot: scan-run: sast-quick-522 finished. 34 findings. top-rule=exec-path-injection.
may: Looks like the deploy-runner@redwood svcacct lost KMS access. I see Cloud KMS denies at 02:14 UTC. Audit snippet: protoPayload.methodName=\"cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.access\" protoPayload.status.code=7 principalEmail=\"deploy-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\".
rachael: (typo) rebind or revert? We should rebind the decrypt role and collect evidence before we suppress.
ton y: Rebind seems faster. Command: gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/build-key --member=serviceAccount:deploy-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
may: Applied at 02:21 UTC. gcloud response: \"Updated IAM policy.\" Extracted logs with: gcloud logging read \"protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\\\"deploy-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com\\\" AND protoPayload.status.code=7\" --limit=100 --format=json > ci-kms-deny-522.json
rachel: Opening SEC ticket and requesting a 3h suppression for staging infra/* while we validate scans. Need PR diff, KMS logs, and pre/post scan artifacts to attach.
build-bot: Suppression created: infra/* @staging by rachel  expires in 3h.
ton y: Manual sast re-run shows findings down to 4. Looks like the noisy hits were the temporary fallback files.
audit-bot: Evidence checklist: attached logs (ci-kms-deny-522.json), PR link https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1212, scan artifacts sast-quick-522 (before) and sast-manual-522 (after).
may: Will add a line to the infra PR template to include KMS perms verification in role-change checklist.
rachel: Thanks. After suppression expiry we'll confirm and close the ticket. Also scheduling a short review in tomorrow's sec-sync to decide if we should add a premerge KMS-deny smoke test.
